surviving_claim.plain_language: A discovery controller can prevent local route stopping, provider failure, or duplicate coverage from being misreported as task completeness by retaining unresolved material routes as open obligations; the present evidence establishes this behavior on controlled and exact contracts but not external retrieval superiority.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: The paper turns an often implicit acquisition-versus-closure distinction into an executable control contract, shows where a comparator that drops unavailable material routes violates that contract, and retains an adverse public-collection stress test rather than presenting the method as a retrieval improvement.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The paper could collapse into internal governance unless the route-stopping versus task-closure distinction changes an information-retrieval decision a reader recognizes.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Keep the public TREC-COVID and BEIR stress tests visible, state the control-layer consequence in field language, and make no performance or completeness claim.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Dependent controlled variants, authored exact-contract labels, and an unverified registration claim could inflate authority.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Use 78 controlled topic clusters rather than 390 variants for inferential interpretation, call exact-contract results conformance, and report the TREC-COVID analysis as post-hoc/descriptive.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The formal layer composes prior retrieval, stopping, memory, provenance, and obligation mechanisms and cannot support broad theorem novelty.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Claim only the tested task-level aggregation residual and preserve the information-equivalent 400/400 comparator tie.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Reproducible same-programme contracts could be mistaken for independent scientific validation.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Separate byte/replay integrity from scientific validity and retain same-programme agreement as conformance evidence only.

hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The paper could be a feature union of existing retrieval, stopping, evidence-synthesis, and provenance mechanisms or overlap a sibling ORION paper.
hostile_panel.closure_test: Name the closest acquisition and stopping systems, subtract their mechanisms explicitly, and retain the unique question of what local acquisition outcomes may certify about global closure.

scientific_mass.independent_unit_type: Mixed bounded units: controlled topic cluster, exact-contract family-by-archetype cell, TREC-COVID topic, and BEIR corpus
scientific_mass.dependence_notes: The 390 controlled tasks collapse to 78 topic clusters; the 400 exact-contract cases collapse to 40 family-by-archetype cells; 50 TREC-COVID topics and three BEIR corpora are kept separate. These heterogeneous units are never pooled into one population estimate.
scientific_mass.failure_opportunities: Controlled cases include unavailable material routes, duplicate coverage, question-processing shifts, low-utility but material routes, and unavailable non-material decoys; exact contracts include 40 family-by-archetype cells; public stress tests can show lower recall, higher cost, false closure, or decision-inert successors.
adverse_or_null_results: TREC-COVID recall@100 is lower by 0.01769 and reads increase by 175.7% against the strongest observed comparator.
The information-equivalent exact-contract comparator ties the controller at 400/400.
Density-normalized and query-conditional successors leave all five ArguAna decisions unchanged.
OpenAIRE/Crossref comparisons remain undetermined after provider-validity failure.
The fresh 48-task campaign was not accessed and contributes no result.

novelty.component_novelty: Generic lexical, semantic, graph, citation-expansion, stopping, memory, provenance, and evidence-obligation components are treated as prior work.
novelty.composition_novelty: The composition makes route-local stopping and task-global closure separate authorities while retaining unavailable material routes in the closure denominator.
novelty.emergent_result: A comparator assembled from prior mechanisms matches route-local decisions but violates 150 exact closure labels when it removes unresolved material routes; an information-equivalent comparator ties, isolating the residual to the declared closure contract.
novelty.theory_lineage: The formalism is positioned as a control contract drawing on retrieval stopping, provenance, finite-source certificates, question-conditioned memory, and evidence-bound workflow obligations, not as a new general theorem family.

comparisons.minimum_mechanism: A minimal controller stores route materiality and state, keeps unavailable material routes unresolved, and permits task closure only when every material route satisfies its closure condition.
baseline_roles: authored prior-mechanism comparator without unresolved-route closure semantics
fusion and generic active-stopping BEIR references

external_validity.description: Historical public TREC-COVID and BEIR collections supply descriptive stress tests; the strongest positive mechanism result remains controlled/authored.

integrity_evidence: independent numerical recalculation of TREC-COVID headline values
scientific_validity_evidence: explicit retention of provider-invalid and unaccessed outcomes

sibling_overlap.merge_test: ORION-12 uniquely asks what acquisition outcomes authorize about route and task closure; removing it from a merge would remove the unavailable-material-route aggregation result and its adverse retrieval stress tests.

next_discriminator.task: For any future external-benefit claim, prospectively bind comparator selection, margins, cost rule, bootstrap analyzer, and public data before outcome access.
next_discriminator.why_it_changes_decision: That study could test retrieval benefit beyond the present control-contract claim.
next_discriminator.closure_test: A separately timestamped protocol and deterministic analyzer reproduce a protected external comparison without post-outcome rule changes.

decision.reason: The bounded methods paper has a reader-visible control problem, multiple non-pooled evidence families, an isolated aggregation residual, fair information-equivalent comparison, and retained adverse public evidence; broader external-performance claims remain outside scope.
